Mindset & Goals
categories.description: From the manifestation video: define it, write it, visualise it, check FTBA alignment, then take one real action. No guaranteed outcomes — clarity plus action.

prompts.prompt: Create a professional, scroll-stopping social media graphic about [TOPIC] for [TARGET AUDIENCE]. Design style: modern, premium, visually striking, and clean. Use a strong visual hierarchy, bold typography, balanced spacing, high contrast, and a cohesive color palette that matches the topic. Main headline: "[INSERT HEADLINE]" Supporting text: "[INSERT SUBTITLE OR KEY MESSAGE]" Make the headline immediately readable on a mobile screen. Use a compelling visual element that reinforces the message, and arrange all elements using professional graphic design principles. Ensure perfect alignment, consistent margins, clean edges, and plenty of negative space. Avoid clutter, unnecessary decorations, generic stock-photo aesthetics, distorted elements, and overlapping text. Make the final result look like it was designed by an experienced art director for a premium brand. Format: 1080 × 1350 pixels, portrait orientation, optimized for Instagram and Facebook. Important: Render all text exactly as provided, with correct spelling and no additional words.
prompts.summary: A premium, mobile-readable graphic with one headline, one message, and no clutter.
prompts.title: Social Media Graphic

prompts.prompt: Design a high-end promotional flyer for [EVENT NAME], aimed at [TARGET AUDIENCE]. Event details: Date: [DATE] — Time: [TIME] — Location: [VENUE OR ONLINE] — Call to action: [BOOK NOW / REGISTER / GET TICKETS]. Visual direction: bold, sophisticated, attention-grabbing, and professionally art-directed. Use a striking hero image or central visual that communicates the event's atmosphere. Combine expressive typography with a clear information hierarchy. Make the event name the dominant element. Arrange the date, time, venue, and call to action in clearly defined sections. Use a maximum of two complementary font families, precise alignment, consistent spacing, and a refined color palette suited to the event. Create depth through intentional lighting, shadows, textures, and layered elements where appropriate. Ensure every detail remains legible at a glance. Avoid overcrowding, excessive effects, random font combinations, and amateur template aesthetics. Format: 1080 × 1350 pixels, portrait orientation, suitable for social media promotion. Render all supplied text accurately. Do not invent event details or add unrequested text.
prompts.summary: One dominant event name, with date, time, venue and CTA in clean sections.
prompts.title: Event Flyer

prompts.prompt: Create a premium, photorealistic advertising graphic for [PRODUCT NAME], designed to attract [TARGET AUDIENCE] and encourage them to [DESIRED ACTION]. Product description: [DESCRIBE THE PRODUCT AND ITS MAIN BENEFIT]. Headline: "[INSERT HEADLINE]" Supporting copy: "[INSERT SHORT BENEFIT OR VALUE PROPOSITION]" Call to action: "[SHOP NOW / DISCOVER MORE / ORDER TODAY]". Art direction: luxury commercial photography meets modern advertising design. Position the product as the hero, using cinematic lighting, realistic materials, refined shadows, beautiful reflections, and a visually compelling background that complements the product. Use a sophisticated composition with strong visual hierarchy. Keep the product sharp, recognizable, and proportionally accurate. Place the headline and supporting text strategically so they enhance the product rather than compete with it. Use a cohesive color palette, premium typography, generous negative space, and precise alignment. The result should look like a professionally produced campaign for an established consumer brand. Avoid artificial-looking product textures, distorted packaging, excessive visual effects, clutter, and unsupported product claims. Format: 1080 × 1350 pixels, portrait orientation, optimized for social media advertising. If a product reference image is provided, preserve its actual appearance, branding, packaging, and proportions. Render all text exactly as supplied.
prompts.summary: Product as hero, cinematic light, honest claims, copy that supports — not competes.
prompts.title: Product Advertisement
variables: DESCRIBE THE PRODUCT AND ITS MAIN BENEFIT
INSERT SHORT BENEFIT OR VALUE PROPOSITION
SHOP NOW / DISCOVER MORE / ORDER TODAY

prompts.prompt: Design a visually striking, typography-led poster featuring the exact phrase: "[INSERT MAIN PHRASE]" Optional supporting text: "[INSERT SUBTEXT]" Create an editorial design that feels like the work of an award-winning graphic designer. Make typography the primary visual element rather than relying on photographs or illustrations. Use expressive, oversized lettering, carefully controlled line breaks, intentional scale contrast, precise kerning, and a strong typographic grid. Combine no more than two complementary type styles to create tension, rhythm, and visual impact. Choose a bold color palette of [INSERT COLORS] and use negative space strategically. Every letter must be crisp, readable, and perfectly aligned. Use subtle textures, geometric accents, or restrained graphic elements only when they strengthen the composition. The poster should feel contemporary, distinctive, and suitable for a premium creative studio, fashion editorial, or design exhibition. Avoid generic layouts, excessive decoration, inconsistent spacing, distorted lettering, and unnecessary text. Format: 1080 × 1350 pixels, portrait orientation. Reproduce the supplied wording exactly, with no spelling mistakes or extra text.
prompts.summary: Type as the image — oversized lettering, tight grid, two type styles max.
prompts.title: Typography Poster

prompts.prompt: Transform the following information into a visually engaging, easy-to-understand infographic about [TOPIC]. Target audience: [TARGET AUDIENCE]. Information to include: [PASTE FACTS, STEPS, STATISTICS, OR EXPLANATIONS]. Design style: clean, modern, editorial, and professionally structured. Organize the information into clearly separated sections with descriptive headings, concise supporting text, and simple visual representations. Create a strong hierarchy with one prominent title, clearly numbered steps or sections, consistent typography, and a cohesive color palette. Use relevant icons, diagrams, arrows, or simple charts to make complex information easier to understand. Ensure every element aligns to a consistent grid. Maintain balanced spacing, readable text, consistent icon styles, and sufficient contrast. Make the infographic easy to scan in under 30 seconds on a mobile device. Prioritize factual accuracy and clarity over decoration. Do not invent statistics, alter supplied figures, or introduce unsupported claims. If information is missing, leave it out rather than guessing. Avoid clutter, excessive text, unnecessary icons, confusing chart designs, and inconsistent visual styles. Format: 1080 × 1350 pixels, portrait orientation, optimized for Instagram and Facebook. Preserve the exact meaning of the supplied information and render all text as accurately as possible.
prompts.summary: Facts into a 30-second scan — numbered sections, one title, no invented stats.
prompts.title: Infographic
variables: PASTE FACTS, STEPS, STATISTICS, OR EXPLANATIONS

prompts.prompt: Create an exceptionally refined luxury brand graphic for [BRAND NAME], a [BRAND CATEGORY] brand targeting [TARGET AUDIENCE]. Brand message: "[INSERT MESSAGE OR CAMPAIGN HEADLINE]" Visual direction: understated luxury, sophisticated art direction, premium editorial aesthetics, and timeless elegance. Use a restrained color palette featuring [INSERT COLORS], elegant typography, deliberate negative space, balanced proportions, and meticulous alignment. Incorporate premium materials and subtle textures such as brushed metal, fine paper, polished stone, silk, glass, or soft directional lighting when appropriate for the brand. Create a distinctive focal point that feels intentional and expensive. The composition should resemble a luxury fashion campaign or a premium branding studio's portfolio, with every visual element serving a purpose. Avoid excessive gold effects, generic luxury clichés, unnecessary ornaments, crowded layouts, cheap-looking gradients, and overly decorative fonts. Keep the design minimal but memorable. Ensure the brand name and headline are crisp, legible, and positioned with precision. Format: 1080 × 1350 pixels, portrait orientation, suitable for premium social media campaigns. If a logo or brand reference is provided, preserve its original design and proportions. Do not invent brand credentials, product features, or additional copy.
prompts.summary: Understated luxury — restraint, negative space, one intentional focal point.
prompts.title: Luxury Brand Graphic

prompts.prompt: Create a high-impact, click-worthy YouTube thumbnail for a video titled "[VIDEO TITLE]". Main subject: [PERSON / PRODUCT / OBJECT]. Core concept: [DESCRIBE THE BIG IDEA OR VISUAL STORY]. Thumbnail text: "[INSERT 2–5 WORDS]" Design the thumbnail using professional YouTube art direction. Communicate one clear idea instantly, even when viewed at a small size on a mobile screen. Use a dominant focal point, strong subject separation, expressive but natural facial expressions if a person is present, dramatic yet believable lighting, high contrast, and a clean background. Arrange the subject and headline so they complement each other without competing for attention. Use large, bold, highly legible typography with precise alignment, clean edges, and consistent spacing. Make the most important words visually dominant. Use color contrast strategically to guide the viewer's eye toward the main subject and headline. Create curiosity through visual storytelling, contrast, scale, or an unexpected element relevant to the video. Make the result feel polished, credible, and professionally edited rather than exaggerated or misleading. Avoid clutter, tiny text, excessive arrows, unnecessary circles, random effects, distorted faces, and misleading visual claims. Format: 1280 × 720 pixels, 16:9 aspect ratio. Keep essential text and subjects safely within the frame. Render the thumbnail text exactly as provided, with correct spelling and no extra words.
prompts.summary: One idea at thumbnail size — dominant subject, 2–5 words, no clickbait tricks.
prompts.title: YouTube Thumbnail
variables: DESCRIBE THE BIG IDEA OR VISUAL STORY

prompts.prompt: Based on my skills, experience, knowledge, and interests, give me 10 digital product ideas I could create and sell online. For each idea, explain the target audience, the problem it solves, and why someone might want it.
prompts.summary: 10 ideas from your own skills, each with audience, problem and reason to buy.
prompts.title: Find Your Product Idea

prompts.prompt: I want to create a digital product about [TOPIC]. Help me turn my knowledge into a valuable product. Suggest the best format, such as an ebook, guide, template, checklist, course, or toolkit, and explain exactly what it should include.
prompts.summary: Pick the right format for a topic — and exactly what goes inside it.
prompts.title: Turn Your Knowledge Into a Product

prompts.prompt: Create a complete structure for my digital product about [TOPIC]. Break it into clear sections or chapters and include the key information, examples, exercises, templates, and actionable steps that would make the product genuinely useful.
prompts.summary: A full chapter structure with examples, exercises and action steps.
prompts.title: Create the Product Structure

prompts.prompt: Help me create the content for each section of my digital product. Make it practical, easy to understand, specific, and actionable. Avoid generic advice and include examples, frameworks, checklists, and step-by-step instructions wherever relevant.
prompts.summary: Section-by-section content that is practical, specific, and usable.
prompts.title: Create the Actual Content

prompts.prompt: Write a compelling sales page for my digital product. Include a strong headline, the problem it solves, who it is for, what is included, the key benefits, common objections, FAQs, and a clear call to action. Do not make unrealistic or guaranteed claims.
prompts.summary: Headline to FAQ to CTA — persuasive without unrealistic promises.
prompts.title: Create the Sales Page

prompts.prompt: Create a 30-day content strategy to promote my digital product on [PLATFORM]. Give me daily content ideas, hooks, captions, CTAs, and content formats designed to attract my target audience and naturally lead interested people toward the product.
prompts.summary: 30 days of daily ideas, hooks, captions and CTAs for one platform.
prompts.title: Create a Promotion Strategy

prompts.prompt: Turn this raw video into a polished 30-second Instagram Reel. Remove pauses, awkward moments and unnecessary sections. Improve the pacing, add natural jump cuts, create engaging captions, and structure the video to keep viewers watching until the end. Do not change what I am saying.
prompts.summary: Raw footage to a tight 30-second Reel, wording untouched.
prompts.title: Turn Raw Footage Into a Reel

prompts.prompt: Analyze this video like a professional short-form content editor. Identify the parts most likely to hold attention and restructure the video for maximum retention. Create a stronger opening hook, remove unnecessary parts, tighten the pacing and suggest where captions, zooms and visual changes should appear.
prompts.summary: Retention-first restructure — stronger hook, tighter pacing, visual cues.
prompts.title: Make It More Viral

prompts.prompt: Create accurate, engaging captions for this video. Highlight the most important words, keep each caption short and easy to read, and format them for a vertical 9:16 video. Make the captions feel modern and designed for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.
prompts.summary: Short, readable 9:16 captions with the key words highlighted.
prompts.title: Create Captions

prompts.prompt: Edit this video by identifying and removing filler words, long pauses, repeated sentences, mistakes and sections that don't add value. Keep my natural speaking style and make the final video feel fast-paced without making it sound unnatural.
prompts.summary: Cut filler and pauses, keep the voice natural — not robotic.
prompts.title: Remove the Boring Parts

prompts.prompt: Analyze this long video and identify the 10 strongest moments that could work as separate short-form videos. For each one, give me the exact start and end point, a strong hook, suggested caption and a title.
prompts.summary: One long video, 10 clipped moments with timestamps, hooks and titles.
prompts.title: Create Multiple Clips

prompts.prompt: Take this video and turn it into 5 separate short-form videos. Give each video a different hook and angle while keeping the original information accurate. Structure each one for maximum retention and make sure none of them feel repetitive.
prompts.summary: 5 distinct angles from one video, no repetition, facts intact.
prompts.title: Turn One Video Into a Content Series

prompts.prompt: Analyze this video sentence by sentence and tell me exactly where I should add B-roll, screenshots, animations or other visual elements. For every suggestion, describe what should appear on screen and why it improves the viewer's understanding or attention.
prompts.summary: Sentence-by-sentence B-roll map — what to show, and why.
prompts.title: Add B-Roll Suggestions

prompts.prompt: Give this video a professional social-media edit. Improve the pacing, suggest appropriate cuts, captions, B-roll, transitions and visual emphasis. Keep the style clean and modern. Avoid excessive transitions or effects that make the video look amateur.
prompts.summary: A clean professional pass — no effect overload, no amateur transitions.
prompts.title: Make the Video Look Professional

prompts.prompt: Analyze the first 5 seconds of this video. Give me 10 alternative hooks that would make someone stop scrolling. Keep them relevant to the actual content and avoid misleading clickbait. Then rewrite the first 10 seconds using the strongest hook.
prompts.summary: 10 honest hooks for the first 5 seconds, then a rewritten opening.
prompts.title: Create a Stronger Hook

prompts.prompt: Turn this video into a complete short-form content package. Create versions optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and Facebook. Give me the recommended duration, hook, caption style, title, on-screen text and CTA for each platform.
prompts.summary: One video, four platform versions with duration, hook, text and CTA each.
prompts.title: Repurpose for Every Platform
Define Your Goal in Writing
prompts.summary: Turn a vague wish into one specific written goal — what, why, and what success looks like.
prompts.prompt: Help me define my biggest goal clearly, in writing. My goal area is [GOAL AREA], and what I want in broad terms is [BROAD GOAL]. Ask me up to 5 short clarifying questions, one at a time if needed, then help me write it as one specific sentence: what I will achieve, by [TIMEFRAME], and how I will know it is done. Then add two lines: why it matters to me, and what my life looks like on a normal day once it is achieved. Keep it concrete and measurable where possible. Do not promise that writing it down guarantees the outcome.

prompts.title: Visualize Your Future Life
prompts.summary: A guided visualization of a normal day in the life you want — then what it tells you to do.
prompts.prompt: Guide me through a visualization of my future life if I achieve [GOAL]. Start with a normal day [TIMEFRAME] from now: where I am in the morning, what work I am doing, who I am with, and how I feel at the end of the day. Keep it vivid but realistic — no fantasy wealth or fame unless that is the actual goal. After the visualization, ask me three questions: which part felt most motivating, which part felt most believable, and which part felt furthest away. Then help me turn the most motivating part into one practical next step.

prompts.title: FTBA Alignment Check
prompts.summary: Audit Feelings, Thoughts, Beliefs and Actions around one goal — and spot where they conflict.
prompts.prompt: Help me check my FTBA alignment for this goal: [GOAL]. For each of the four — Feelings, Thoughts, Beliefs, Actions — ask me what is actually true right now, not what I wish were true. Then make a simple table: for each one, what supports the goal and what works against it. Highlight any direct conflict, for example a belief that says 'I can't' paired with an action that avoids the work. Finish with the single biggest misalignment and one small change I can make to it this week. Do not diagnose mental health conditions or replace professional support.

prompts.title: Build Honest Affirmations
prompts.summary: Five believable, action-linked affirmations — no hype, no guaranteed results.
prompts.prompt: Help me write 5 affirmations for my goal: [GOAL]. They must be believable to me, written in the present tense, and linked to an action I actually control — for example 'I show up and do the work' rather than 'I am already rich.' Avoid claims that affirmations alone guarantee results, and avoid anything that contradicts facts I give you. For each affirmation, add one line: the daily action that backs it up. Then give me a 2-minute morning routine for reading them and picking today's action.

prompts.title: Pre-Sleep Visualization Routine
prompts.summary: A calm 5-minute routine to imagine tomorrow's goal before sleep — and plan the morning.
prompts.prompt: Create a 5-minute pre-sleep routine for my goal: [GOAL]. Step 1: one minute to write down tomorrow's single most important action. Step 2: three minutes to quietly imagine doing that action well, step by step, including one obstacle and how I handle it. Step 3: one minute to let it go and rest. Keep the tone calm and practical, not hyped. Include exactly what to write, what to picture, and what to do if my mind wanders. Do not claim this technique guarantees results while I sleep.

prompts.title: One Action Today
prompts.summary: From a big goal to exactly one doable action today, in under a set time.
prompts.prompt: From my biggest goal — [GOAL] — help me pick exactly one action I can take today in under [TIME AVAILABLE]. It must be specific (what, where, when), small enough to actually finish today, and clearly move me closer to the goal. Give me the action, the first physical step to start it, and what 'done' looks like. If I give you excuses or obstacles, help me shrink the action rather than dropping it. End with a one-line check-in I can answer tonight: did I do it, yes or no, and what got in the way if not.

prompts.title: Find Why You Stalled
prompts.summary: The 'number-one mistake' audit: why past attempts stalled, in feelings, beliefs and actions.
prompts.prompt: Help me find why I stalled on this goal before: [GOAL]. Ask me about my last serious attempt: what I tried, how long I kept going, where I stopped, and what I told myself at the time. Then sort the causes into three groups: unclear goal, conflicting belief, and missing or inconsistent action. Name the most likely main cause in plain language, with evidence from my own answers — do not invent a cause I did not mention. Finish with one different approach for this attempt that directly addresses that cause, and one early warning sign that I am stalling again.

prompts.title: Daily Focus Practice
prompts.summary: A simple morning / midday / evening practice to stay focused on one goal.
prompts.prompt: Build me a simple daily practice to stay focused on my goal: [GOAL]. I have about [MINUTES PER DAY] minutes total. Split it into three short parts: morning (pick today's one action and read my goal sentence), midday (a 1-minute check: am I on track, yes or no, and what is next), and evening (review what I did, what I learned, and tomorrow's one action). Make it fit on one page, use my own words where I give them, and keep every step under 5 minutes. Include a weekly review question: what worked, what didn't, and what changes next week. Do not add extra habits, apps, or purchases I did not ask for.
